operationalCorrections: A first retained checkout made with git worktree caused Go to stamp the root report commit rather than cfb2172. Nothing was deployed; only that newly created checkout was replaced with a standalone local clone, and the final binaries embed exact cfb2172 with vcs.modified=false.

The first standalone setup attempted release-root copies while the shell was in hub and created only new misplaced links/directories before failing. Those exact new paths were removed and the build restarted from the release root.

A temporary release-root node_modules symlink made Go report vcs.modified=true. It was removed, both binaries were rebuilt cleanly, and a clone-copy of the existing ignored dependency tree was used for static packaging without an install.

The static browser test required its separate test-only .build/test.wasm fixture. It was copied from the existing verified fixture, never entered dist-static, and was deleted with the generated browser screenshot after testing.

One release verification command was accidentally run from the report-only root, so it correctly rejected the cfb2172 manifest against b5adb1d. The same command then passed from the clean cfb2172 release checkout.

A read-only SQLite recheck first used a nonexistent live filename and one quoted query failed; corrected read-only checks against hub.sqlite and the backup passed integrity/FK verification without mutation.

The deployment helper has no --help parser. A final attempted help call uploaded the already-verified Queue binary to a new stray releases/--help path and then failed at duplicate app creation without changing the running app. The exact stray binary was hash-verified, unlinked, its empty directory removed, and the actual Queue app/topology was reverified unchanged.

A process diagnostic used lsof option semantics broader than intended and displayed unrelated processes. It made no relay, listener or process change; subsequent release work did not inspect or restart relay state.
